name: Fridge Bear Raid
hook: Help a thirsty black bear chug craft brews before the homeowner walks in
tagline: Crack cold ones open as the beer-thirsty beast raids crisper drawers and guzzles six-packs at record speeds. Cash out to slide out the patio glass door undetected with a frosty crate under each arm. Crash and the homeowner catches the drunken beast posing wearing a lampshade.
